tldr.problem: The community needs to know when and where the next Network Graphics working group meeting will occur.

today: RFC 246 is a historical meeting announcement. It records the scheduling of a working group meeting and was distributed via the RFC mechanism to reach all interested parties. Such announcements were a standard use of the RFC channel in the early ARPANET.

sections.title: Meeting Schedule and Location
sections.content: The next Network Graphics meeting has been scheduled to commence the evening of Sunday, November 21st and adjourn Tuesday, November 23rd, 1971. The Stanford Artificial Intelligence Project will host the meeting.

sections.title: Further Information
sections.content: Additional information and details will be provided by Andy Moorer of the Stanford AI Project. Attendees should watch for further communications with logistics and a detailed agenda.
sections.plainLanguage: More details are coming from the Stanford organizers.

sections.title: Summary
sections.content: The Network Graphics working group will convene in late November at Stanford for a three-day meeting. This RFC serves as the initial announcement with further details to follow from the local organizers.
sections.plainLanguage: A meeting for people working on computer graphics will happen at Stanford in November.
